description: Revenue Operations Manager - HubSpot (w/m/d) Deine Rolle Du entwickelst das HubSpot-Setup von LIQID weiter: Du baust Workflows, Automationen und Integrationen, die Sales und Relationship Management im Tagesgeschäft unterstützen und machst aus den Daten im System ein Reporting, auf das sich Team und Führung verlassen können. Den laufenden Betrieb der Plattform hältst du dabei stabil: Berechtigungen, Lizenzen, Datenqualität, Dokumentation. Der Schwerpunkt deiner Arbeit liegt jedoch auf dem Bauen, nicht auf dem Verwalten. System und Team HubSpot Sales Hub und Service Hub sind in diesem Jahr frisch implementiert. Du triffst also kein fertiges System an, das verwaltet werden will, sondern eine Plattform im Aufbau. Entsprechend groß sind der Gestaltungsspielraum und die Verantwortung für saubere Grundlagen. Du berichtest an den Lead Revenue Operations und arbeitest eng mit Sales und Relationship Management zusammen. Deine Aufgaben Baue Workflows, Sequences, Pipelines und Lead Routing in HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub und Service Hub: von der Verteilung eingehender Leads über Meeting-Links bis zu automatischen Aufgaben in Sales und Relationship Management. Übersetze Anforderungen aus Sales und Relationship Management in konkrete HubSpot-Logik und löse wiederkehrende Handarbeit durch Automationen ab. Kollaboriere mit unserem Data Team bezüglich Datenaustausch und -aufbereitung zwischen den relevanten Kernsystemen. Verbinde HubSpot mit dem übrigen TechStack, also Aircall, Google Workspace, Notion und Slack, über native Connectoren, APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools. Entwickle das Toolstack sinnvoll weiter. Entwickle unseren Sales Prozess kontinuierlich inhaltlich weiter und optimiere die technische Implementierung und Erfolgsmessung. Baue Reports und Dashboards, die Pipeline, Aktivitäten und Ergebnisse für Sales, Relationship Management und Führung nachvollziehbar machen. Verwalte Nutzer, Teams und Berechtigungen im laufenden Betrieb und halte die Konfiguration dokumentiert, statt sie im Kopf zu behalten. Schule Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Umgang mit HubSpot und beantworte als erste Anlaufstelle Fragen zum System. Das bringst du mit Mindestens 3 Jahre praktische Arbeit mit HubSpot oder einem vergleichbaren CRM wie Salesforce. Sicherer Umgang mit HubSpot Marketing Hub, Sales Hub und Service Hub, insbesondere als Admin und mit Workflows, Properties, Pipelines und Reporting. Erfahrung im Bau von Integrationen über APIs, Webhooks oder Automatisierungstools wie Zapier oder Make. Verständnis für CRM-Datenmodelle und die Fähigkeit, Datenqualität über Standards und Automationen zu sichern statt über Nachpflege. Erfahrung mit der Prozessgestaltung erfolgreicher Vertriebsprozesse sowie deren Umsetzung in CRM-Systemen. Erfahrung darin, fachliche Anforderungen aufzunehmen, in Systemlogik zu übersetzen und Entscheidungen so zu dokumentieren, dass andere daran weiterarbeiten können. Fähigkeit, technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu erklären und Kolleginnen und Kollegen ohne Systemhintergrund zu schulen. Deutsch auf verhandlungssicherem Niveau (B2) für die Zusammenarbeit mit den Fachbereichen und Englisch auf gutem Arbeitsniveau. Von Vorteil HubSpot-Zertifizierungen Erfahrung mit gängigen Automatisierungslösungen wie n8n, zapier oder make.com Erfahrung in einem regulierten Umfeld, etwa Finanzdienstleistungen Erfahrung mit einer CRM-Migration oder einem CRM-Rollout Grundkenntnisse in JavaScript oder Python für Custom-Code-Actions Du erfüllst nicht alle Anforderungen? Bewirb dich trotzdem bei uns! Wir sind gespannt auf deine Bewerbung! Das bieten wir dir Vielfalt: Flache Hierarchien und kulturelle Offenheit machen dich ab Tag 1 zum integralen Bestandteil unseres bunten Teams aus internationalen Talenten. Flexibilität: Wir machen dein Leben nicht kompliziert. In flexiblen Arbeitsmodellen, Arbeitszeiten und Mobile-Working-Regelungen findest du die richtige Balance. 28 Tage Urlaub und 2 zusätzliche freie Tage am 24. und 31.12. verschaffen dir zudem entspannte Auszeiten. Wertschätzung: Du gestaltest mit uns die Zukunft des digitalen Wealth Managements in einem innovativen, mehrfach ausgezeichneten Unternehmen auf Wachstumskurs, mit hoher Marktrelevanz und viel Raum für deine Ideen. Entwicklung: Wir unterstützen deine persönliche und fachliche Entwicklung mit einem jährlichen Development-Budget von 3.000€. Außerdem erhältst du zu Beginn deiner Tätigkeit bei LIQID ein hochwertiges Equipment, bestehend aus MacBook, Kopfhörern und Display. Smart Money: Als LIQIDian erhältst du attraktive Konditionen für unsere Anlagestrategien, einen monatlichen Lunch-Zuschuss und exklusive Discounts bei verschiedenen Anbietern. Wohlbefinden: Regionale Bio-Produkte halten Dich vor Ort im Office fit – und unsere Gesundheitsinitiativen oder unser Health Assistance Programm auch weit darüber hinaus. Über uns Wir sind LIQID, einer der führenden digitalen Vermögensverwalter in Europa und eines der am schnellsten wachsenden deutschen Fintechs. Jouw rol Bij Heras krijg je de kans om als stagiair bij te dragen aan het Nimble-programma: een strategisch verbeterprogramma gericht op het vereenvoudigen en automatiseren van bedrijfsprocessen. Als stagiair werk je aan het verbeteren van processen binnen domeinen zoals sales, projecten in nieuwbouw en finance. Je analyseert hoe processen vandaag werken en vertaalt dit naar slimme oplossingen met behulp van Power BI en Power Automate. Je levert concrete procesverbeteringen, procesbeschrijvingen, automatiseringen en Power BI dashboards voor operationele en financiële sturing aan alsmede werkende Power Automate flows. Tenslotte lever je een meetbare bijdrage aan efficiëntie (bijv. tijdbesparing of minder fouten). Jouw werkzaamheden In kaart brengen van huidige processen en knelpunten. Automatiseren van handmatige processen met Power Automate. Ontwikkelen van dashboards en rapportages in Power BI (zonder daadwerkelijk programmeren). Verbeteren van datakwaliteit en inzicht in KPI’s. Samenwerken met business teams en IT-specialisten. Benieuwd naar de ervaringen van een stagiair bij Heras? De eerste indruk: dynamisch in plaats van stoffig - Heras Nederland Wie zijn wij? Heras is een vooraanstaand Europese totaalleverancier van permanente perimeter protection oplossingen. Wij opereren vanuit meer dan 24 landen en hebben meer dan 1100 hoogopgeleide experts in dienst. Opgericht in 1952, vervult en overtreft Heras de beveiligingsbehoeften van klanten in heel Europa. Het is dankzij deze staat van dienst, samen met het blijvend groeiende vakmanschap van onze medewerkers, dat wij ons experts in perimeter protection kunnen noemen. Onze cultuur, werksfeer & waarden Wij hebben binnen Heras een informele, open en toegankelijke cultuur. We zijn trots op ons werk, producten en dienstverlening. We hebben een no-nonsense mentaliteit, tonen ondernemerschap, zijn energiek en werken allemaal gedisciplineerd volgens de drie kernwaarden; betrokkenheid, betrouwbaarheid en deskundigheid. Heras is gewaardeerd op een Ecovadis Zilveren Ster en dat plaatst ons bij de duurzaamste 15% bedrijven van Nederland. OMRON Connect is one of the largest digital health platforms in our ecosystem, connecting millions of users with their healthcare data through OMRON devices. It is about making thoughtful engineering decisions, modernising step by step, and building a cloud platform that gives our engineering teams the foundations, tooling and confidence they need to deliver safely and independently. Your work will have a direct impact on the reliability, scalability and cost-efficiency of a platform serving several million monthly active users across the world. You will help shape our cloud and engineering standards, introduce modern practices where they genuinely add value, and make Infrastructure as Code, observability and safe continuous delivery the default rather than the exception. By creating reusable infrastructure, improving developer experience and removing unnecessary complexity, you will help teams move faster without compromising reliability or security. Along the way, you will collaborate with engineers, influence technical direction and leave the platform in a significantly better state than you found it. title: Manager, Engineering - Product
description: At ClickUp , we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. We're looking for an Engineering Manager to lead a product engineering team at ClickUp. This is an open team placement role: you'll join a product team based on your strengths and our business priorities, rather than being hired into a single predefined product area. Across teams, the mandate is the same: build a strong team, ship useful product improvements, and take ownership of the quality and reliability of what you deliver. Engineering Managers at ClickUp are hands-on. You'll lead from the front: reading and reviewing code daily, debugging production issues alongside your team, prototyping when it unblocks a decision, and shipping code yourself when the team needs it. Your technical credibility is how you earn trust, set the bar, and make good calls quickly. You'll also own people management, delivery, and team execution. Working closely with product, design, and technical leads, you'll turn customer problems into clear priorities and achievable milestones. You'll develop engineers, make trade-offs explicit, and keep work moving without letting quality or maintainability become someone else's problem. You'll also run an AI-native team . We structure work so AI agents can read it, route it, roll it up, and report on it. Progress and team health should be visible from real signals, with reporting available self-serve rather than dependent on status meetings. We want a manager who has used AI to remove busywork and improve how a team builds, and who can help engineers use it responsibly across planning, implementation, testing, and operations. Responsibilities Lead and develop a product engineering team. Own hiring, onboarding, mentorship, performance, and career growth, and build a team where expectations are clear and feedback is direct. Own delivery from planning through release and follow-through. Break work into clear milestones, manage dependencies, surface risks early, and make realistic commitments. Set priorities with product, design, and engineering leadership. Connect engineering work to customer needs and business outcomes, and make deliberate trade-offs between new features, reliability, and technical debt. Lead from the front technically. Stay close to the codebase: review PRs, dig into production issues, write code and prototypes when it unblocks the team, and know your systems well enough to spot risk before it ships. Drive architecture and implementation decisions with your technical leads and senior engineers. Bring real depth to design discussions, challenge assumptions with specifics, and make the call when the team is stuck. Run an AI-native team. Use AI tools and agentic workflows to improve planning, development, testing, triage, and reporting, while maintaining clear ownership and human review where it matters. Uphold a high engineering bar across design and code review, automated testing, performance, security, and maintainability. Build quality into delivery rather than treating it as a final checkpoint. Own the operational health of your team's product area. Establish appropriate monitoring, safe rollout practices, incident response, and on-call ownership, and turn production issues into lasting improvements. Collaborate across product teams and shared platform teams to resolve dependencies and deliver coherent customer experiences. Keep priorities, progress, risks, and decisions visible. Use evidence to improve team execution and product outcomes, rather than optimizing for activity counts. Requirements 6+ years of professional software engineering experience building production software, including substantial time as a hands-on senior engineer, with 2+ years managing an engineering team. You still code. You're comfortable working in a modern production codebase (TypeScript, Node.js, React, or similar), reviewing PRs with substance, and debugging across the stack. A track record of delivering customer-facing SaaS products or services, with ownership extending beyond launch to reliability, maintenance, and customer outcomes. Experience hiring, coaching, and developing engineers, including giving direct feedback, managing performance, and supporting career growth. Deep technical judgment. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs from first-hand experience, and hold a high engineering bar because you know what good looks like in the code. Experience partnering closely with product and design to define priorities, scope work, and deliver against clear milestones. A demonstrated ability to use AI tools and agentic workflows to improve engineering work and reduce manual coordination, with attention to correctness, security, and review. Comfort working through ambiguity, learning unfamiliar product areas, and making decisions with incomplete information. Clear communication and effective cross-functional collaboration. You make ownership, trade-offs, risks, and next steps easy to understand. Daily fluency with AI tools in your own workflow. Preferred Qualifications Recent, meaningful code contributions as a manager: features, fixes, tooling, or prototypes you shipped yourself. Experience managing engineers across frontend and backend, or leading delivery across multiple technical disciplines. Experience building and operating software at scale, including performance, reliability, safe migrations, and incident management. Experience in a fast-moving product organization, balancing customer-facing delivery with platform improvements and technical debt. Experience introducing AI-native or agent-driven workflows to an engineering team, with measurable improvements in quality or execution. Experience building collaboration, productivity, or workflow software, or products used by both individual users and enterprise customers. Experience leading distributed teams across time zones. Equal Opportunity Employer ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. Privacy Notice ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice. If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details. Visa Sponsorship Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions. Fraud Alert ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @ clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com . We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com. AI Processing Notice ClickUp may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to help review and screen candidates' employment applications against role-related criteria. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision‑making. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.

title: Principal Engineer, Duo Agent Platform
description: GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster. The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software. * Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab. About the role We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle. Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work. The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. raw.jobDescription:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

About the role

We are looking for a Principal Engineer to help build GitLab Duo Agent Platform, the agentic orchestration layer that runs AI agents and flows across the entire software lifecycle.

Principal Engineers at GitLab are recognized experts across multiple technology domains and represent the senior technical leadership within their organization. In this role you will set technical direction for a significant part of the Agent Platform, working across several teams to turn agentic capabilities into something engineering organizations can actually depend on: predictable, observable, governable, and fast enough to sit in the critical path of real development work.

The Agent Platform is not a single service. It spans agent execution and orchestration, flow definition and event-driven triggering, the AI Catalog through which customers discover and manage agents, model routing and evaluation, and the governance surface that decides which agents may act where and under whose identity. It runs on GitLab.com, GitLab Dedicated, and Self-Managed installations, including deployments that use self-hosted models to meet compliance requirements. You will work on the parts of that system where the hard architectural questions live, and you will do it hands-on.

This role reports into the VP of the AI Engineering organization and works closely with Engineering Managers, Staff Engineers, Product Management, Infrastructure and Security.

What you'll do

  • Define the technical direction for a significant area of Duo Agent Platform across several teams, and partner with Engineering Managers and Product to turn it into a roadmap with a six-month horizon.
  • Build the orchestration layer that makes agents and flows reliable: session lifecycle, tool invocation, context assembly, concurrency, retries, timeouts, and failure modes that degrade gracefully instead of stalling a developer's workflow.
  • Hands on work on driving topics throughout the whole organisation from POC level, architecture to full implementation.
  • Participate in Incident Management on-call rotation, to help meet availability goals for GitLab.com.
  • Strong product builder and ownership mentality. Understanding of product strategy, technical strategy, delivering customer value and iteration towards a successful product
  • Write clear, opinionated design documents, architecture narratives, and decision records that let other teams make aligned decisions. Ensure the architecture holds across multi-tenant GitLab.com, Dedicated, and Self-Managed deployments, including self-hosted model configurations, and respects data governance boundaries in each.
  • Use the platform on our own work, find where it falls short of what we claim, and feed that back through improvements into the product.
  • Mentor Staff and Senior Engineers, and raise the bar for experimentation rigor and cross-team collaboration.
  • Work across the whole platform on different projects, features and teams. This reaches across:
    • Design the extensibility surface so customers can build custom agents and flows, connect their own tools and internal systems, and bring external agents such as Claude Code and Codex into GitLab workflows without weakening the platform's guarantees.
    • Drive down the cost and latency of agentic requests, and work with Product on how model selection, routing, and credit consumption behave as usage grows.
    • Define the evaluation practice for the platform: offline benchmarks and online experiments that measure task completion, correctness, tool-call accuracy, latency, and cost per task, and that catch regressions before customers do.
    • Build the governance and safety surface with Security and Compliance: policy-driven controls over which agents and models may run where, permission and identity semantics that align to existing roles and group structure, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, traceability of every flow session, and audit that stands up to enterprise review.
  • Complete Interview Training and participate in hiring for the department as a technical interviewer or panel member.

What you'll bring

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years at Staff, Principal level or equivalent senior technical leadership.
  • Hands-on production experience building on large language models: agent loops, tool calling, context management, retrieval, prompt and model evaluation. Experience shipping this to real users, not only prototyping it.
  • Strong background in distributed systems, including service decomposition, fault tolerance, observability, and operational resilience under multi-tenant load.
  • A track record of defining evaluation frameworks and using benchmark and experiment results to make architecture decisions, rather than shipping on intuition.
  • Experience designing human-in-the-loop controls, safety guardrails, and responsible AI practices for systems that act on a customer's behalf.
  • Ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product, Infrastructure, and Security on problems that start out ambiguous.
  • Experience mentoring senior engineers and shaping technical direction across multiple teams without direct authority.
  • Comfort working in one or more of Ruby, Go, Python, or TypeScript, and willingness to work across the stack the platform spans.
  • Excellent written and asynchronous communication, and the ability to work effectively in a fully remote, globally distributed organization.

About the team

The AI engineering organisation is building the product and infrastructure that make GitLab an effective environment for running agents across the software development lifecycle. We’re distributed across the world and partner with teams throughout GitLab to help the GitLab Duo Agent Platform become the backbone of GitLab's AI features. You will report directly to the VP of Engineering for AI and especially work together with all the teams, the engineering management and other principal engineers in the AI department. This is an opportunity to lead a consequential group as AI changes how software is built.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. See more information on our benefits and equity. description:
Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

Why Deliveroo (part of DoorDash)

Deliveroo, part of the DoorDash group, is building the leading local commerce platform, connecting consumers, merchants, and couriers in real time. Paris is one of our most strategic and complex markets globally, with unmatched density, brand concentration, and competitive intensity.

As we move towards our 2026 ambition, we are evolving our commercial organisation to match the scale and sophistication required to win in Paris. This includes increased seniority, clearer regional ownership, and stronger execution across Inner and Outer Paris.

The Senior Client Partner – Paris Inner Ouest role is a newly strengthened position, designed to combine strategic partner leadership, regional ownership, and organisation building.

As a Senior Client Partner, you'll lead a team of Account Management Lead, Senior Account Manager and Account Manager and you will report to the Regional Director of Paris, part of the Commercial team. The position is based in Paris. 

You are accountable for the growth and performance of strategic brand portfolios across one of Paris’ most critical zones. Beyond partner management, this role plays a central part in aligning the organisation to business challenges and ambitions. You will design, lead, and continuously evolve the account management setup to ensure the right level of seniority, coverage, and execution quality across the territory. 

This is a senior leadership role with direct impact on revenue, partner satisfaction, and team development.

4. Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Partner closely with Operations, Marketing, Product, Strategy, and Finance

  • Represent your portfolio and organisation in Paris and France leadership forums

  • Influence roadmap and prioritisation through structured partner and market feedback

Experience

  • 10+ years in commercial, client partnership, or account management roles
  • Proven experience managing complex, strategic brand portfolios
  • Demonstrated success leading multi-layered teams in fast-paced environments
  • Experience in F&B, Hospitality, Retail, FMCG, or Marketplace businesses preferred
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen (P&L understanding)

This role offers significant scope, visibility, and influence in shaping how Deliveroo wins in Paris.

title: Billing & Analytics Software Engineer
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. About the Role As a Billing & Analytics Engineer on the Console & Analytics team, you will own the systems that turn Deepgram’s raw API usage into accurate invoices, revenue-grade analytics, and the self-service billing experience our customers depend on. This is the financial backbone of a high-growth AI company: every dollar of revenue flows through the code you build and maintain. raw.jobDescription:
Company Overview

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

Company Operating Rhythm

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

About the Role

As a Billing & Analytics Engineer on the Console & Analytics team, you will own the systems that turn Deepgram’s raw API usage into accurate invoices, revenue-grade analytics, and the self-service billing experience our customers depend on. This is the financial backbone of a high-growth AI company: every dollar of revenue flows through the code you build and maintain.

You will design and operate the full billing pipeline—from usage event ingestion and metering through aggregation, rating, invoicing, and integration with third-party billing and CRM platforms. You’ll also own the analytics surfaces that give customers visibility into their consumption and give internal teams the data they need to operate the business. This role pulls billing and analytics engineering out of the broader Console team, creating a dedicated function that insulates and accelerates Deepgram’s product-led growth (PLG) effort.

Usage Metering & Event Processing: Design, build, and maintain the pipeline that ingests, validates, and processes usage messages from Deepgram’s inference and voice agent services. Ensure events are captured with sub-second reliability at scale, with idempotency and exactly-once semantics to guarantee billing accuracy.

Usage Aggregation & Summarization: Build the aggregation layer that rolls raw usage events into usage summaries—by customer, product, time window, and pricing dimension. Optimize for query performance so that both real-time dashboards and end-of-period billing runs operate within SLA.

Billing System Integration: Own the integration with usage-based billing platforms (M3ter, Metronome, or equivalent). Implement rating, plan management, and invoice generation logic. Ensure billing data reconciles cleanly with usage records and that edge cases (overages, credits, mid-cycle plan changes, enterprise commitments) are handled correctly.

CRM & RevOps Integration: Build and maintain integrations with Salesforce and RevOps tooling to synchronize customer accounts, contract terms, entitlements, and billing status. Partner with Finance and RevOps to ensure billing data supports revenue recognition, forecasting, and audit requirements.

Console Billing Experience: Develop the customer-facing billing and usage views within the Deepgram Console. Build clear, actionable dashboards that show real-time and historical usage, current spend, billing history, and plan details. Design the self-service flows for plan upgrades, payment method management, and invoice retrieval.

In-DC Access, Permissions & Token Management: Own the billing-adjacent authorization surfaces: API key and token management, usage-based access controls, entitlement enforcement, and the permission model that gates feature access based on customer plan and billing status. Ensure these systems are secure, auditable, and performant.

Analytics & Reporting: Build internal analytics pipelines and dashboards that surface usage trends, cohort behavior, conversion funnels, and revenue metrics to Product, Growth, and Finance teams. Instrument the billing system for operational observability—alerting on anomalies, reconciliation failures, and SLA breaches.

Data Integrity & Reconciliation: Implement automated reconciliation between usage events, aggregated summaries, billing records, and payment processor data. Build alerting and self-healing mechanisms to catch and resolve discrepancies before they impact customers or revenue reporting.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of experience building and operating billing, payments, metering, or financial data systems in a SaaS or usage-based pricing environment.

  • Strong backend engineering skills, preferably in Rust, and in at least one of: Python, TypeScript/Node.js, Go, or similar. Comfort working across the stack when needed.

  • Deep experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and data pipeline design—schema modeling, query optimization, and high-volume event processing.

  • Hands-on experience integrating with billing or subscription platforms (e.g., Stripe, M3ter, Metronome, Chargebee, Zuora) and CRM systems (Salesforce).

  • Understanding of usage-based pricing models, metering patterns, and the edge cases that come with them (proration, overages, commitments, credits, multi-currency).

  • Experience building reconciliation and data integrity systems that ensure financial accuracy at scale.

  • Strong communication skills—you can partner effectively with Finance, RevOps, Product, and Growth teams to translate business requirements into reliable systems.

  • A security-conscious mindset, especially around authentication, token management, and access control.

  • Experience with usage-based billing platforms (M3ter, Metronome) specifically, or building custom metering systems from scratch.

  • Experience with analytics/BI tooling (Looker, Metabase, dbt) and building internal data products.

  • Prior work at a company where billing accuracy directly impacted customer trust and revenue at scale.

Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers on best practices, design patterns, and coding standards. Advocate for your team's technical priorities and ensure alignment within the broader engineering organization. Participate in product discovery sessions to assess feasibility, explore patient needs, and validate ideas through prototypes and experiments. Collaborate with UX/UI designers to create intuitive, engaging interfaces that help patients understand and act on their information, improving completion and engagement. Break down complex projects into clear, actionable tasks and lead execution to successful outcomes. Elevate engineering standards by improving workflows, processes, and tools to increase development velocity and quality. Analyze product, operational, and patient feedback metrics to identify optimization opportunities and drive continuous improvement. Create and maintain technical documentation for architecture, integrations, experiments, and development processes. Conduct code reviews and contribute to knowledge sharing initiatives across the team. Model a culture of open communication, feedback, and continuous learning by coaching and supporting teammates at all levels. You Have: 5+ years of professional experience building production web products with strong full stack skills in React/Next.js and Node/TypeScript (or similar). Proven experience delivering scalable, high quality web applications and services in a modern cloud environment. Experience building and operating third party integrations and asynchronous, event driven workflows (queues, webhooks, retries, idempotency) where correctness and reliability matter. Proficiency in front end technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, React, Next.js, GraphQL) and back end technologies (Node.js, Nest.js, PostgresDB, Redis, Amazon SQS). Track record of shipping experiment driven features that improved conversion, activation, or retention; comfortable with feature flag systems and experimentation platforms such as GrowthBook, Optimizely, or LaunchDarkly. Strong analytical and data skills, including event instrumentation, debugging analytics, and writing basic SQL or partnering with Analytics to define success metrics and guardrails. Deep product mindset: cares equally about UX, copy, and pacing as about architecture and APIs; approaches problems with iterative, testable solutions. Experience with Agile development methodologies and CI/CD pipelines, including automated unit and integration testing. Excellent problem solving abilities and sound judgment in balancing speed, quality, and impact. Strong communication and collaboration skills with the ability to align partners, make tradeoffs explicit, and drive initiatives from idea to execution. Highly organized, self directed, and capable of prioritizing multiple projects to meet goals with minimal oversight. Bonus: experience in healthcare or another regulated domain (HIPAA, PHI handling), or with third party partner integrations and industry data standards. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply—even if you're not sure if your background or experience is a perfect match. Hims considers all qualified applicants for employment, including applicants with arrest or conviction records, in accordance with the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, the California Fair Chance Act, and any similar state or local fair chance laws. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability. Hims & Hers is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Hims & Hers gives consideration to all qualified applicants without regard to any protected status, including disability. Please do not send resumes to this email address. The Opportunity

Voice is the most natural modality for human interaction with machines. However, current sequence modeling paradigms based on jointly scaling model and data cannot deliver voice AI capable of universal human interaction. The challenges are rooted in fundamental data problems posed by audio: real-world audio data is scarce and enormously diverse, spanning a vast space of voices, speaking styles, and acoustic conditions. Even if billions of hours of audio were accessible, its inherent high dimensionality creates computational and storage costs that make training and deployment prohibitively expensive at world scale. We believe that entirely new paradigms for audio AI are needed to overcome these challenges and make voice interaction accessible to everyone.

The Role

Deepgram is seeking a highly skilled and versatile Machine Learning Engineer to join our Research team. As a Member of the Research Staff, you will partner with research scientists to prototype and validate novel modeling ideas, then scale them through robust training systems for speech technologies, internal tooling, and innovative data strategies. You'll work at the intersection of machine learning, data infrastructure, and internal tooling to support our mission of building world-class speech recognition and synthesis systems. On the Research team, you will experiment with new technologies and techniques, while also working on product-focused deliverables, learning from colleagues with a wide range of expertise in AI and machine learning as you go.

Key Responsibilities

  • Scalable Model Training: Architect and manage horizontally scalable systems that dramatically accelerate the end-to-end training lifecycle for Speech-to-Text (STT) and Text-to-Speech (TTS) models. This includes far more than automated training: the role focuses on making model development significantly faster and more efficient through optimized data preparation and management, high-throughput training pipelines, distributed infrastructure, and automated evaluation tooling.

  • Tooling & Accessibility: Design and implement internal UIs and tools that make ML systems and workflows accessible to non-technical stakeholders across the company. These UIs should be designed to provide transparency and flexibility to internally built tooling.

  • Infrastructure & Tools: Oversee and manage training tooling, job orchestration, experiment tracking, and data storage.

We are seeking Members of the Research Staff who:

  • See "unsolved" problems as opportunities to pioneer entirely new approaches

  • Can identify the one critical experiment that will validate or kill an idea in days, not months

  • Have the vision to scale successful proofs-of-concept 100x

  • Are obsessed with using AI to automate and amplify your own impact

If you find yourself energized rather than daunted by these expectations—if you're already thinking about five ideas to try while reading this—you might be the researcher we need. This role demands obsession with the problems, creativity in approach, and relentless drive toward elegant, scalable solutions. The technical challenges are immense, but the potential impact is transformative.

It's Important to Us That You Have

  • Strong experience with the machine learning research pipeline, particularly in STT or related speech domains. This includes experimenting with and evaluating new architectures and modeling approaches, and implementing large-scale training systems.

  • Proficiency with orchestration and infrastructure tools like Kubernetes, Docker, and Prefect.

  • Familiarity with ML lifecycle tools such as MLflow.

  • Experience building internal tools or dashboards for non-technical users.

  • Hands-on experience with data engineering practices for unstructured audio and text data.

  • Comfortable working in cross-functional teams that include researchers, engineers, and product stakeholders.

Why Join Deepgram?

At Deepgram, you’ll help shape the future of human–machine communication. Our research culture prioritizes ownership, experimentation, and real-world impact. As a Member of the Research Staff, you'll be empowered to build tools and systems that accelerate ML research and product deployment at scale.

title: People AI & Automation Engineer
description: Company Overview Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram. Company Operating Rhythm At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset—AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance. Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do. Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5. About the Role We are building the next generation of People Operations at Deepgram. We're looking for an early-career engineer to partner directly with our Head of People to identify, design, and build AI-powered workflows that fundamentally change how People Ops operates. You will not be maintaining an HRIS or administering traditional People systems. You will build the systems that sit on top of them. You'll take manual, repetitive, high-friction People processes and turn them into intelligent workflows using AI, automation, APIs, internal tools, and agents. You'll work across People, Engineering, IT, and other functions to build secure, scalable solutions that allow employees and managers to get answers and complete workflows without requiring a People team member for every interaction. This is a highly hands-on role for someone who loves building, experimenting, and finding ways to make work dramatically more efficient. What You'll Do Partner directly with the People & Talent Team to identify high-impact opportunities to apply AI and automation across People Operations. Build an AI-first onboarding experience that is scalable, up to date, and provides an exceptional experience. Turn manual People workflows into automated, AI-powered systems. Build AI agents and workflows that can answer questions, gather information, initiate processes, and complete defined actions. Integrate AI systems with existing tools, including HRIS, Slack, recruiting, performance, compensation, and other internal systems. Build internal tools and interfaces that make People processes dramatically easier for employees, managers, and the People team. Prototype quickly, test with real users, learn from what works, and iterate. Establish appropriate human-in-the-loop controls, escalation paths, permissions, and safeguards for sensitive People workflows. Partner with Engineering and IT on architecture, security, access controls, and productionizing successful prototypes. Measure whether what you build actually saves time, improves the employee experience, or increases the quality and consistency of People Operations. Notice : We're aware of individuals impersonating Deepgram recruiters. All legitimate Deepgram recruiting communication comes from an @ deepgram.com email address. If you've received a message claiming to be Deepgram, please forward it to careers@deepgram.com.

title: Senior Finance Manager
description: About GRI Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) is the independent nonprofit organization that is the architect of the common global language to assess and report on environmental, social, and economic impacts. GRI provides standards, tools, and training that empower organizations of all sizes to create sustainable, long-term value and unlock positive change in the world. For over 25 years, GRI has led a global multi-stakeholder process to develop and refine rigorous yet practical approaches to sustainability reporting, which meet the needs of all stakeholders. The GRI Standards, the world’s most widely used sustainability reporting standards, provide the building blocks for transparent reporting on impacts. Working at GRI, you will be part of unlocking positive change in the world. About the role The Senior Manager Finance owns budgeting and financial analysis to support the CFO and budget holders in business decision-making. The role also oversees day-to-day finance operations, financial controls and external reporting, and provides line management and guidance to a finance colleague. Driving automation and process improvement is a central part of the role, using digital tools and AI where appropriate to streamline workflows, automate reporting and reduce manual work. Initially focused on finance, this remit may expand to other processes across GRI in the longer term. Responsibilities Delivery Own and deliver the budgeting, forecasting and financial planning cycle, providing the CFO with robust analysis, scenario modelling, automated dashboards and clear recommendations, while automating data collection and reporting to reduce manual effort and support business decision-making. Lead process improvement and automation across finance, using digital tools and AI where appropriate to reduce manual work and improve accuracy, timeliness and efficiency, and extend this to other administrative processes across the organization in the longer term. Maintain strong financial controls, building automated checks and workflows where possible, and, with support from the finance and grant management teams, manage external reporting including consolidated financial statements (under IFRS for SMEs), tax reporting and donor financial reporting. Provide line management, guidance and development to a finance colleague, overseeing day-to-day finance operations (including payments, reconciliations and month-end close) and coaching them to streamline and automate routine tasks. Engagement Act as a finance business partner to budget holders, providing insight into performance, challenging assumptions and supporting informed resource allocation. Support the CFO in liaising with external partners, including auditors and banks, coordinating information requests and ensuring timely follow-up. Communicate financial insights clearly to non-financial colleagues and support adoption of new reporting tools and processes. Requirements Work experience Holds a degree in Finance (Diploma, Master’s, or higher), preferably complemented by a professional accounting qualification (ACCA, ACA, CIMA or equivalent). Brings over 5 years of relevant experience in a similar senior financial role. Demonstrable experience delivering finance process improvements, automation and reporting tools within budgeting, close and reporting cycles. NGO or grant-funded experience is an advantage, not a requirement. Proven experience providing line management and guidance to a finance colleague and overseeing day-to-day finance operations, including reviewing transactions and reconciliations and ensuring timely, accurate month-end close and financial reporting. Experience supporting budgeting and forecasting and maintaining robust financial controls. Experience in managing operational budgets exceeding €10 million. Knowledge and abilities Strong digital finance and financial modelling skills, with hands-on experience using ERP systems, analytics and reporting platforms such as Power BI, and advanced spreadsheet and workflow automation tools. Familiarity with AI tools and their practical application to finance and administration; experience developing AI agents is a strong advantage. A practical, improvement-oriented mindset, with the ability to turn business needs into effective finance tools and workflows; experience applying automation or AI tools in finance is an advantage. Ability to solve problems and complexities spanning different functions and processes. Is capable of setting clear priorities and ensuring an optimum use of time and resources. Is accurate, reliable, and knows how to deal with confidential information. Has strong communication and collaboration skills. Has excellent written and oral skills in English. Additional languages are a plus. Ability to work in a dynamic environment where change is ongoing. Able to work in an international and multi-cultural setting. Affinity with the mission GRI. What we offer Remote and/or hybrid work (within +/- 2 hour CET; (candidates must have an existing permit to work in the country identified). Work hours: Full-time (40hrs/week) Flexible work schedule Contract type: 1-year fixed-term contract with possibility for extension Start date: ASAP Salary: EUR 56,057 - 77,857 gross per year on full-time basis, depending on experience and location Generous leave allowance. Access to the GRI Academy. The application deadline for this position is 12 November 2026 at 12:00 (noon) CEST. Applications received after this date will not be considered. title: Senior Systems Software Engineer, GPU Compute
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

We’re looking for a Senior Software Systems Engineer to join our team and play a key role in the development of our cutting-edge hyperscaler platform. The GPU & InfiniBand team is responsible for enhancing and optimizing the core components of our Cloud platform, with a specific focus on GPU computing, InfiniBand networks, and the KVM/QEMU stack. You’ll work closely with hardware virtualization and device emulation technologies, ensuring high performance and security in multi-GPU, HPC environments. The role involves analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving infrastructure to support new hardware, fine-tuning system performance, and automating fault detection and resolution in a complex system.

In this position, you will be responsible for:

  • Tuning the performance of GPU clusters and InfiniBand networks to ensure optimal operation in HPC and GPU-based environments.
  • Analyzing and troubleshooting the root cause of issues related to GPUs and InfiniBand networks, and proposing corrective actions.
  • Integrating new hardware into the existing infrastructure, including support for new GPU hardware through software stacks like Kubernetes, QEMU, and KVM.
  • Enhancing automation systems for proactive monitoring, detecting, and resolving issues in GPU and InfiniBand environments.
  • Configuring and managing GPU devices and InfiniBand fabrics, ensuring efficient and reliable operation.

We expect you to have:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in system-level software development (focused on performance optimization, low-level programming).
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Linux systems (administration, troubleshooting, and performance tuning).
  • In-depth understanding of server architecture, including PCIe devices, NICs, Linux OS/Kernel, and high-performance computing (HPC) systems.
  • Strong proficiency in one or more performance-oriented programming languages (C/C++, Go, Python).

It would be a plus if you have:

  • Experience with GPU end-to-end testing in a cluster environment using InfiniBand networking.
  • Proven track record of analyzing and optimizing the performance of HPC workloads (e.g., simulations, data analysis, AI/ML workloads).
  • Familiarity with RDMA, RoCE, and InfiniBand protocols for high-performance communication.
  • Background in Software-Defined Networking (SDN) and experience with HPC cluster networking.
  • Understanding of QEMU/KVM virtualization and managing virtualized environments.
  • Experience with deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch and TensorFlow, and their integration with HPC systems.
  • Familiarity with collective communication libraries like MPI and NCCL for distributed computing. 

We offer competitive salaries ranging from $170k-$300k + equity based on your experience.

We conduct coding interviews as part of the process.

title: Product Design stage
description: Werken als Product Design stagiair in een productgedreven bedrijf met een heldere missie? Dat kan bij Crisp! Wij willen beter eten voor meer mensen beschikbaar maken. Als Product Design Stagiair help je, samen met een ijzersterk team, de ervaring van de inmiddels tienduizenden gebruikers van de Crisp-app naar een hoger niveau te tillen. Kom jij ons team versterken vanaf februari 2027? Wat je gaat doen Je geeft mede vorm aan hoe AI en ons Design System elkaar versterken en je bouwt mee aan de toekomstige werkwijze voor Product Design en Frontend Development. Zo draag je direct bij aan elke stap in ons ontwerpproces, van het eerste onderzoek en prototyping tot de uiteindelijke implementatie. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Product Designers en in-house developers. Je krijgt de ruimte om echt impact te maken. We werken op hoog niveau en waarderen een proactieve houding en een gezonde dosis eigen initiatief. Dit ben jij Je volgt een relevante hbo- of wo-opleiding, zoals Computer Science, Communication & Multimedia Design, Interaction Design of Strategic Product Design. Je hebt affiniteit met design, AI en front-end development. Die passie laat je bijvoorbeeld zien door middel van (het begin van) een portfolio of met relevante projecten. Je hebt al wat ervaring met Design Systems in Figma en AI-coding tools (zoals Claude Code, Cursor, Codex of iets anders) en vindt het leuk om daar nog behendiger in te worden. Je hebt bij voorkeur (beginnende) ervaring met React (Native) of vergelijkbare frond-end frameworks. Je bent leergierig, kritisch en durft vragen te stellen. Je onderbouwt je keuzes en staat open voor feedback. Je spreekt en schrijft vloeiend Nederlands en Engels. Wat wij bieden Werken bij een B Corp gecertificeerd bedrijf, waarbij je de kans krijgt om je stempel te drukken op ons voedselsysteem en échte verandering teweeg te brengen. Enthousiaste en ondernemende collega’s om mee te werken en te leren. Een kijkje in de keuken van een van de snelst ontwikkelende bedrijven in de Europese markt. Een gratis lunch van Crisp. Elke maand food for thought, met workshops en talks via de Crisp University. Tijd om je collega’s te leren kennen tijdens sport, events en proeverijen. Aandacht voor je mentale gezondheid met online begeleiding van erkende psychologen via OpenUp. En... fikse korting op je Crisp boodschappen, omdat je thuis natuurlijk ook goed wilt eten. Onze selectieprocedure Solliciteer via onderstaande button. Hoe meer je kunt delen over jezelf en de reden dat je solliciteert, hoe beter. Bij Crisp streven we naar een inclusieve en diverse werkomgeving waarin iedereen welkom is, ongeacht hun achtergrond, geslacht, leeftijd, etniciteit, seksuele geaardheid, religie of beperking. Wij moedigen sollicitanten met diverse perspectieven en achtergronden aan om te solliciteren en geloven in gelijke kansen voor iedereen. We waarderen de unieke bijdragen die elke medewerker kan leveren en zijn vastbesloten om een inclusieve werkplek te creëren waarin iedereen wordt gerespecteerd en gewaardeerd. What your journey at Polarsteps will look like on a typical day.

Payment execution and expense handling : Prepare and submit electronic transfers strictly on schedule. Review and process colleague expense reports against company policies. Propose practical improvements to enhance our internal controls and day-to-day efficiency. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks! Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects. raw.title: Backend Engineer – Real-Time Video
raw.description:
About Stream

Stream powers real-time Chat, Video, Activity Feeds, and AI Moderation for more than 1 billion end users across 4,000+ apps, from Strava and Bumble to eBay and Patreon. Our platform processes billions of API requests per month and supports applications with millions of concurrent users, while delivering highly reliable, low-latency services and a great developer experience.

The role

We're looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join Stream on our mission of elevating the quality of apps for billions of users globally. You'll own the technical direction of Stream Video's media plane and the infrastructure it runs on.

This is a full-time role, hybrid with 3 days a week in our Amsterdam office, or remote from anywhere in the EU.

What you'll work on

Stream Video runs on an SFU we built in Go on top of Pion, plus ingest and recording fleets, all on a global edge network we own across more than one cloud. Nobody at Stream has owned this media plane end to end before. Our central infrastructure team is tuned for request-based services, and video breaks in different ways: live sessions can't be dropped, bandwidth is the biggest cost, and placement is the main lever. That's why this is a Staff role. You'll set the direction for the video backend and its infrastructure with your own roadmap, reporting to our Director of Engineering with a direct line to our CTO. The Video SDK teams own the client side, and you'll work closely with them and with infrastructure. Part of the fleet is mid-move to Kubernetes.

Job responsibilities:

  • Architecture: write the architecture and roadmap for Stream Video's backend and media infrastructure, and decide what ships.

  • Scale livestreaming: architect the SFU and media pipeline (WHIP, WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, SVC), including the path from WebRTC to CDN-backed HLS for very large audiences.

  • Own the fleet: reliability, autoscaling, placement, rollouts, observability and cost for long-lived sessions across clouds, with cost per gigabyte as a first-class metric.

  • Gate production changes: define the validation that decides which changes, including AI-generated ones, reach live media, using behaviour tests on realistic networks, nightly telemetry scans and a public quality benchmark.

  • Take the final escalation: handle the hardest quality, latency and production incidents, and work with enterprise customers on advanced integrations.

  • Raise the bar: mentor senior engineers through design review, code review and hiring.

About you

You've owned systems where a dropped session or a bad rollout is visible to users within seconds, and you think about cost and reliability as much as features. You'd rather write the hard design doc than wait for one. A founder background is an asset here. The team is small, so you'll still write and review plenty of code. If you're looking for a large organisation with a platform team to hand problems to, or a management track, this role won't suit you.

You have:

  • Extensive backend engineering experience, including significant time owning architecture for high-scale production systems

  • Expert proficiency in Go or an equivalent systems language (Rust, C++, Java)

  • A track record owning real-time, stateful or latency-sensitive systems at very high scale

  • Deep knowledge of distributed systems and networking: failure modes, placement, capacity planning and cost

  • Strong experience with real-time media or streaming: WebRTC, SFU/MCU concepts, RTP/RTCP, DTLS, or RTMP, SRT and HLS

  • Clear written communication: design docs and RFCs that others can act on

  • Hands-on experience adopting AI coding and agent tools, and judgement on how to make them safe in production

Bonus points:

  • Built or operated an SFU, or contributed to Pion or another WebRTC stack

  • Moved a stateful fleet to Kubernetes, or ran media workloads across more than one cloud

  • Knowledge of bandwidth estimation, congestion control, simulcast, SVC and codecs (Opus, VP8/VP9, AV1)

  • CockroachDB/PostgreSQL, RocksDB, Raft and Redis at scale

  • Experience at developer tooling, API or SDK companies

  • Founder or early-stage startup experience building real-time products

  • Python or Rust alongside Go

  • Conference talks, technical writing or notable open-source work in real-time media

What makes this role exciting

  • Scope: the infrastructure direction for video is yours to run as a product, with the authority to decide what ships.

  • Impact: Video is Stream's most complex product, and many customers run it alongside Chat, Feeds and Moderation, so this work matters across the company.

  • Stack: Go, Pion, WebRTC, WHIP/WHEP, RTMP, SRT, HLS, Protobuf, CockroachDB/Postgres, RocksDB, Raft and Redis, with Claude, Cursor and ChatGPT Codex in daily use.

  • Starting point: a concrete first 90 days. Ship a validation gate on every infrastructure change that reaches production media, and move part of the fleet to Kubernetes with a cost-per-gigabyte number attached.

Why join Stream?

We're a Series B company with offices in Boulder, Amsterdam, Skopje and Toronto, and a team of 140+ people from 37 nationalities. We're backed by Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01 Advisors, Techstars, and Arthur Ventures, with angels including Dick Costolo (ex-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston-Werner (co-founder of GitHub), and Nicolas Dessaigne (co-founder of Algolia).

We'll be straight with you: a startup is more demanding than a large company. There's no fixed playbook, you'll own things end to end, and you'll sometimes pick up work outside your title. That's also what makes it a fast place to grow. If you want real ownership and high scale more than structure and a set career ladder, you'll feel at home here.

What we offer

  • Company equity

  • 28 days paid time off plus Dutch public holidays

  • Pension plan with a company contribution

  • NS Business Card or a company bike, covered

  • Personal development budget of EUR 500 per year

  • Catered lunches in the office

  • MacBook Pro

  • Up to EUR 60 a month toward a gym or sports club membership of your choice

  • Highly skilled migrant (kennismigrant) visa sponsorship and relocation support if you're moving to Amsterdam

This list applies to Netherlands-based employees and is adjusted to your location of residence. If you work remotely from another EU country, you'll be employed through our Employer of Record partner and get company equity plus local benefits depending on your country of employment.

Our culture

Stream is a casual, transparent team that aims high and supports each other. In engineering, we care about ownership and quality, and our goal is to ship stable software. Management stays hands-on, with less middle management and more time spent doing the work. If that sounds like the environment you want next, apply now.

raw.title: Active Directory engineer (parttime 24 uur)
raw.description:
Ben jij die Active Directory engineer die een bijdrage wilt leveren aan de toekomst van onze Active Directory en geïnteresseerd en bedreven is in PKI/Encryptie toepassing? Voel jij je thuis in een organisatie waar informatie beveiliging hoog op de agenda staat?

Waar jij het verschil maakt

Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor het operationeel en veilig houden van onze Active Directory omgeving, onder andere door middel van dagelijkse controletaken en onderzoeken van verstoringen. Je vervult een prominente rol in het voorkomen en opheffen van digitale dreigingen en security incidenten.

  • Je beheert & configureert Active Directory group policies conform de beleidslijnen op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging

  • Je beheert en optimaliseert de Active Directory omgeving (accounts, OU’s, groups en policies)

  • Je automatiseert zoveel mogelijk beheerwerkzaamheden met o.a. Powershell, Ansible en Terraform

  • Je werkt gevraagd en ongevraagd aan toekomst-vaste verbeteringen van onze Active Directory omgeving, waaronder forest upgrades en Active Directory redesign

  • Je werkt doorlopend aan remediation activiteiten die kunnen voortvloeien uit baseline scans, risico-analyses en security assessments.

Je toekomstige collega's

Je werkt in het Team Data&Webdiensten van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur (IGI). We opereren middels een Agile methodiek, in combinatie met ITIL. Een actieve bijdrage wordt verwacht in het succes van deze werkmethode, dit uit zich oa in het opstellen van kwalitatief goede story’s en Epics, het actueel houden van jouw story’s op het Azure DevOps bord, actieve en constructieve deelname aan events als dag-starts, planning, review en retrospectives. De totale omvang van de afdeling Generieke Infrastructuur is ongeveer 30 experts die werkzaam zijn in Heerlen en Den Haag. Het Data&Webdiensten Team bestaat uit ca 15 collega’s die in Heerlen en Den Haag werkzaam zijn. Plezier in het werk vinden we belangrijk en dat is dan ook verankerd in onze kernwaarden.


Dit ben jij

Je bent gericht op het continu verbeteren: je signaleert, adviseert, voert uit, reflecteert en pakt de regie en verantwoordelijkheid, zowel in samenwerking als op inhoud.

Daarnaast verwachten wij:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau.

  • Aantoonbare ervaring als senior Active Directory beheerder van complexe Windows Server omgevingen in een enterprise omgeving.

  • Kennis en ervaring met het configureren en beheren van Active Directory, Group policy en Powershell. Je beschikt over relevante MS certificering.

  • Kennis van kaders zoals ISO27001, BIO, NIS2 en het toepassen van security baselines, zoals CIS.

  • Ervaring met het (periodiek) uitvoeren van verschillende Active Directory back-up/ restore en -recovery strategieën.


Feitelijk goed geregeld

Voor onze arbeidsvoorwaarden volgen wij de CAO Rijk. Dat betekent dat je onder andere kunt rekenen op het volgende:

  • Een salaris van minimaal € 4132,- en maximaal € 6275,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur. Afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring. Als je bij de start van je functie nog niet over alle benodigde kennis en ervaring beschikt, kan worden gekozen voor tijdelijke inschaling in een lagere salarisschaal. Hierover maak je bij de start van je functie afspraken met je leidinggevende.
